scope: Navigation-scope property and lifecycle contracts: back dispatch, pop scopes, page storage, restoration scopes, and the modal barrier. Router/transaction redesign stays with W4 and is out of scope. A fresh PopScopeController may pop (blocking is opt-in); BackRegistration tokens own their registrations. This ledger covers only this family; it does not claim whole-codebase completeness.
